checks.label: ENTAILED
checks.rationale: The candidate implements a conjunction requiring all three stated factors: regulated services, provision as a business, and business carried on in Hong Kong.
representation_quotes:
Declared output convention: TRUE_IS_SATISFIED
Used facts:
services_are_regulated: The assessed services of the assessed office constitute at least one regulated activity under the referenced Ordinance after applicable regulated-activity carve-outs have been resolved. The Type 9 intra-group carve-out does not automatically resolve other activity types. (truth value)
services_provided_as_business: The assessed office is carrying on a business in providing those same services. Supply through case-specific judgment considering occupation or duty requiring attention, continuity, capacity for profit and profit purpose, without treating the list as an exhaustive conjunction. Retain the genuine single-family arrangement, reimbursement, profit-objective and ordinary-course qualifications; unresolved wording or evidence leaves this fact unknown. (truth value)
business_carried_on_in_hong_kong: The same business providing the assessed services is carried on in Hong Kong, as determined from the circumstances. This is not merely the location of clients, shared premises or an unrelated business. (truth value)
Scope: true
Result: all of these conditions hold: [the fact services_are_regulated; the fact services_provided_as_business; the fact business_carried_on_in_hong_kong]
Result type: bool
Supplied classifications requiring judgment: services_are_regulated, services_provided_as_business, business_carried_on_in_hong_kong. Their assessment is not implemented by this formula.
Runtime semantics: Missing or temporally unavailable facts evaluate as UNKNOWN. For Boolean conjunction FALSE dominates UNKNOWN; for disjunction TRUE dominates UNKNOWN; otherwise uncertainty is retained, and NOT UNKNOWN is UNKNOWN. A conflicting fact anywhere in the rule dependency closure blocks evaluation with CONFLICT even on an unselected branch. A false scope returns OUT_OF_SCOPE; an unknown scope returns UNKNOWN; an unknown IF condition returns UNKNOWN without choosing either branch. No UNKNOWN, CONFLICT or ERROR is converted to a known Boolean.

source_evidence.quote: The issue of whether a single family office is required to be licensed under the Ordinance is determined by reference to three key factors, all of which must be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation: firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.
